issues.title: Expanded sidebar crowds mobile viewport
issues.description: The static sidebar consumes roughly half the vertical height, leaving insufficient space for workspace content.
issues.evidence: Sidebar navigation list extends down to mid-screen above the chart card.
issues.suggestion: Collapse sidebar into a mobile sheet or drawer menu on narrow screens.
issues.triageNote: Eval page deliberately composes an inline static sidebar (collapsible="none" + h-auto w-full) on a 390px phone, bypassing the component's Sheet mobile branch; a component-level auto-collapse/icon-rail would break this page's intended full-width band (and pair-042 is the only inline usage), so a usage note was added to the source instead.

issues.title: Sidebar label and timestamp text collision
issues.description: Item titles overlap directly with duration timestamps due to missing layout spacing and truncation.
issues.evidence: Scene titles 01 through 04 collide with numeric timestamps such as '41:12' and '0:48' along the right edge of the sidebar.
issues.suggestion: Wrap labels in a flexible container with overflow truncation and allocate dedicated spacing for timestamps.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: SidebarMenuButton reserved no end padding for the absolutely-positioned SidebarMenuBadge (right-1), so truncated labels ran underneath duration badges; fixed with group-has-data-[sidebar=menu-badge]/menu-item:pe-12 on the button base + badge right-1 → end-1 (RTL-correct, LTR-identical).

issues.title: Severe sidebar item truncation
issues.description: The sidebar is rendered side-by-side with main content on a narrow viewport, severely constraining column width.
issues.evidence: Nearly all navigation labels ('Bridge call ...', 'APM traces ·...') and timeline items are heavily truncated.
issues.suggestion: Collapse the sidebar into an overlay drawer on narrow mobile screens.
issues.triageNote: Eval page forces a 9.5rem static sidebar (collapsible="none") side-by-side with main content at 320px; the component truncates labels with ellipsis as designed and cannot restructure the page layout — any component-level auto-collapse would also break pair-042's inline mobile usage. Documented via the mobile usage note in sidebar.tsx.
